We prioritize your privacy and data security. Craft MyCV does not store any user data on its servers. All your designs, creations, and any information you input into the application remain local to your device. By using Craft MyCV, you confirm that you have the rights and eligibility to post, share, or create any form of content on the application. We maintain strict guidelines to ensure a safe and respectful environment for all users. The following content is strictly prohibited:
 1. Nudity or sexually explicit content, including text, images, or audio depicting extreme sexual acts or promoting pornographic services.
 2. Encouragement or endorsement of terrorism, hate groups, or organized crime.
 3. Sale, promotion, or solicitation of sexual services, weapons, or harmful drugs.
 4. Content that incites hatred, violence, or discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or disease.
 5. Intentionally harmful content targeting private individuals.

 We do not allow the posting of graphic or violent imagery, videos, or content that could be distressing or inappropriate for a broad audience. Such content will be removed to ensure our platform remains suitable for everyone. We encourage all users to report any violations of our guidelines using the in-app reporting feature. Your reports will be reviewed promptly, and appropriate actions will be taken. As a user of Craft MyCV, you are responsible for ensuring that the content you create and share complies with our guidelines. You agree not to use the application for illegal, unethical, or harmful purposes. We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected within the app, and continued use of Craft MyCV signifies your agreement to the updated terms.
